description: Soheil Guard's safety check of a token before buying it: can it be sold back (a quote, and on EVM networks a test buy, transfer and sale that sends nothing), hidden fees, who controls the contract and what they can do (mint, pause, block wallets, change fees), freeze and mint authorities on Solana, how much the largest wallets hold, the token's age and who owns its liquidity. Returns verdict (KNOWN, OK, CAUTION, RISKY or NOT_CHECKED) and the findings, worst first, each with a level and a sentence. On EVM networks, Solana, Tron, TON and Sui. A check, not a guarantee. Free; no API key needed.

chainId.description: The network the token is on, a chainId from get_networks

token.description: The token's contract address (the mint on Solana, the coin type on Sui)

name: check_token
title: Check a token with Soheil Guard
